summary: Iteration 3: verified the 3 bug fixes (delete_duel reclaims points, admin image upload + PATCH for existing duels, admin duel tabs). Added /app/backend/tests/test_bugfixes_iter3.py (11 tests) - all PASS. Full regression: 55/56 pytest pass (only known TestEdgeCases::test_brute_force_lockout still fails - pre-existing gap). Frontend E2E on admin panel via preview URL confirms tabs render 'Aktive (n)' / 'Avsluttede (n)' and correctly filter duels by status, ImageUpload controls work (upload, preview thumbnail, form-submit stores /api/files/... URL, edit-img1/edit-img2 PATCH controls persist). Bug 1 was validated E2E via backend API (create duel -> user tips correctly -> admin sets result -> +1 pt -> admin deletes duel -> user drops back by 1) and via UI delete button too. DB cleaned up after tests (duels:0, tournaments:0, tips:0, TEST_* users removed).

minor.issue: Still no brute-force lockout after 5 fails (pre-existing, iterations 1 & 2).
Returns {ok:true} even when the ObjectId is valid but no duel exists (no 404). Minor semantics gap; UX unaffected.
Requests with certain non-browser User-Agents are blocked at CF edge with 403 (only observed with urllib default UA; requests library and browsers work fine). Not a backend bug but worth noting.

issues: 'Legg til' button wraps to two lines at 1920px because column is narrow; consider whitespace-nowrap

action_items: (known) Add rate limiting/lockout on POST /api/auth/login after 5 failed attempts.
(minor) DELETE /api/duels/{id} should 404 when the duel is missing.
(cosmetic) Legg til button in season create form wraps; add whitespace-nowrap.
critical_code_review_comments: delete_duel() decrement loop is O(N) writes over users.update_one; fine at demo scale. Batch with bulk_write for larger user bases.

PATCH /api/duels/{id} (DuelUpdate) has no whitelist on which finished-duel fields may be changed; admin can alter shooter names on finished duels which would silently break shooter profile record aggregation (shooter profile is name-string based). Consider blocking name changes on finished duels or migrating records.
POST /api/upload writes to Emergent object storage but does not delete the previous image when PATCH replaces it - orphan files accumulate.
GET /api/files reads the storage_path from db.files but returns the record's content_type regardless of what object storage says; if content_type in DB is wrong, wrong MIME served.
server.py is now 833 lines; consider splitting auth/duels/tournaments/storage into modules.
test_credentials: admin@riffeltippen.no / Skyting2026! works. Fresh TEST_* users created + cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_QA duels and TEST_ui_* users; ran /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py -> duels:0, users:3 (admin + 2 legacy), tips:0, tournaments:0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New iter3 coverage: test_bugfixes_iter3.py = 11 tests (3 delete-reclaim, 6 upload/patch, 2 status-filter). Run all with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q`; only failure = test_brute_force_lockout (real product gap). Frontend E2E was executed on preview URL (duel-shooter-tips.preview.emergentagent.com) and confirmed admin-tab-active/admin-tab-finished filter correctly and ImageUpload controls (duel-shooter1-img/duel-shooter2-img/edit-img1-{id}/edit-img2-{id}) work end-to-end. Note: /api/files/{path} returns 200 with normal browser/requests UAs but Cloudflare returns 403 for default urllib UA - use requests library.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found in the 3 fixes. All backend endpoints and UI wiring behave as described in the spec.
